_comment: Zone layout tips (shown as 🧭 under the guide step). Acts 1-4 are condensed from POE2Radar src/POE2Radar.Core/Game/zone_notes.json (MIT, originally Path of Levelling 2 notes) plus checks made while playing; interludes from the poe2way.com act guide (0.5) and Reim's guide. Layouts can change with patches.

tips.g1_2: Entering up/left with a bridge right away: Beira and the exit are on your side, Mud Burrow across. Only one bridge: everything is across it
tips.g1_3: Boss is straight left/right/up/down from the entrance
tips.g1_4: Four points in a diamond. Find Grim Tangle or Red Vale first? Grab the waypoint and come back. Red Vale exit is usually the corner with the Brambleghast
tips.g1_5: Usually a spiral — keep the wall off-screen and circle one way. You hear music near an obelisk; one can spawn in the middle
tips.g1_6: Roughly up/left. Some layouts are flipped: start north, go south
tips.g1_7: Follow the walls and take both checkpoints first. Mausoleum and tomb entrances are usually on opposite sides. An edge grave can drop an iron ring
tips.g1_8: Boss lies on the line from the exit through the middle tile. Entered from below? It may be right of centre
tips.g1_9: Boss is usually in the north corner or the middle. Follow the path through the middle
tips.g1_11: Go clockwise along the edge. A big pit means the Crowbell is close. See Ogham Farmlands or Freythorn first? Take the waypoint and come back
tips.g1_12: Irregular layout. Find the last ritual first and the wisps point to the remaining ones
tips.g1_13_1: Usually down/left, exit on the wall opposite the entrance. Una's Lute is past the broken carts
tips.g1_13_2: Follow the edge north. Hit the boss before the tools? Checkpoint to the entrance and follow the wall south
tips.g1_14: Some layouts are flipped. Usually clockwise
tips.g1_15: On each floor find the bridge near the middle first. Floor 1 usually up/right, floors 2-3 the opposite way of the previous floor
tips.g2_1: Boss is down/left or down/right (roughly a Z). Stand at the cliff edge to dodge Rathbreaker's spears
tips.g2_10_1: Roughly a Z; if lost, follow a wall
tips.g2_10_2: Boss usually due north of the entrance. Fire res recommended, watch the mines
tips.g2_2: Find the wall inscription: the side with the bell is Balbala, the other is the exit. Six sister statues mean you are on track
tips.g2_3: Go to the corner opposite the entrance. Lightning res and a Topaz charm help
tips.g2_4_1: Follow the wall clockwise. Exit before the boss? Checkpoint back and go counter-clockwise. The boss tile has a round head-shaped building
tips.g2_4_2: A diamond with bridges at the corners. The first bridge is at the left or right end of the first rectangle. Sarcophagi give level 6-7 skill gems
tips.g2_4_3: Two rectangles joined by a bridge. Bridge south→north: boss up; north→south: boss left. The Elemental Offering event gives a resistance ring
tips.g2_5_1: Follow the wall opposite the waypoint
tips.abyss_intro: The Well of Souls is always top-left
tips.g2_5_2: The bone arch near the entrance points to the boss
tips.g2_6: Seals are along the walls in any direction; the third can be in the middle
tips.g2_7: Head to the far side in the direction of the entrance bridge. The boss is on a long straight bridge like the entrance. Phase 1 stand at 12 o'clock, phase 2 at 3 o'clock
tips.g2_8: The letter is outside a building. Exit is at the far end of the second building block
tips.g2_9_1: Go to the corner opposite the entrance. Stuck? Right bridges ×3 → top-right ×3 → bottom-right ×3, repeat
tips.g2_9_2: Don't miss the Sisters of Garukhan (lightning res) — G-shaped tile
tips.g2_12: Enemies leap behind you and surround you — go slowly. Roughly up/left. Lightning res recommended
tips.g2_12_1: Enemies leap behind you and surround you — go slowly. Roughly up/left
tips.g2_12_2: Enemies leap behind you and surround you — go slowly. Roughly up/left. Lightning res recommended
tips.g3_1: Rootdredge (level 9 skill gem) is around the middle of the swamp. The Orok campfire is north or south of the grassland exit
tips.g3_3: Infested Barrens = wall opposite the entrance, Venom Crypts = one cell of a 3×3 grid, Silverfist = usually the top third. Follow the bottom wall first; if not found, checkpoint back and take the other wall
tips.g3_2_1: Everything is on the edge — follow the wall to the checkpoint and the Matlan Waterways waypoint
tips.g3_7: The boss (a big round clearing) is where the drifting embers fly — checked in play. Usually opposite the entrance, top-right
tips.g3_4: Start at the edge: the corpse is in the middle (follow the wall opposite the entrance). If not in the middle, it is in a corner
tips.g3_5: Follow the wall to the right. Jiquani's Machinarium is on the right wall, the Temple of Chaos on the top wall
tips.g3_6_1: Blackjaw is at the far left or far right. A loot-filter sound gives away the soul core early
tips.g3_6_2: Second generator core: revive at the checkpoint and walk a bit, repeat — it spawns nearby. Reach the boss via the checkpoint at the entrance
tips.g3_8: Waypoint at the start first. Top-right to the wall → bottom-right to the wide area with a checkpoint (ambush) → bottom-right → top-right to the exit. Molten Vault: waypoint only
tips.g3_9: Faster to do after the campaign
tips.g3_11: Roughly top-right or top-left. Past the big arch in the middle go left → right to the end. No boss? Go right again
tips.g3_12: Each floor is a triangle with the exit at a corner. Doors only show on the minimap up close. On floor 2 the boss room is across an impassable hole
tips.g3_14: Same layout as The Drowned City — the boss is where you got ambushed there. Follow the large tiled road
tips.g3_16: Huge altar area with praying enemies → through the arch, the Blood Sacrifice is in the back half. The Black Chambers exit is diagonal from the altar area
tips.g3_17: Cross the first bridge left or right and keep going the same way → checkpoint at the second bridge. Follow the bridges rising from the water
tips.g4_1_1: Head away from the dock; at a wall, follow it
tips.g4_1_2: Long and winding, the boss is at the very end
tips.g4_2_1: Follow it to the end to reach Journey's End
tips.g4_2_2: Follow the winding path to the end. Reach Omniphobia via the checkpoint at the start
tips.g4_3_1: Good XP. Keep the Great White fin for Kaimana in Kingsmarch later (gem reward)
tips.g4_3_2: The Beckoning Clam quest item → pearl necklace reward, worth finding
tips.g4_4_2: Take all three resistance/attribute tattoos. Almost a straight line
tips.g4_4_3: Take the +2 passives and go to town
tips.g4_5_1: Find the Goddess of Justice, then go to Solitary Confinement
tips.g4_5_2: Follow the wall the waves crash against
tips.g4_8b: Nothing in the plaza. Hug the top wall for the Evening Bell (3 Exalted Orbs). Follow the coastal ridge past the village to the boss
tips.g4_10: Pick a wall and follow it all the way to the boss
tips.g4_11_1a: Leave the main hall and follow the wall to Heart of the Tribe. Finishing the league content here gave a Greater Jeweller's Orb (Forbidden Rites)
tips.g4_11_1b: Leave the main hall and follow the wall to Heart of the Tribe. Finishing the league content here gave a Greater Jeweller's Orb (Forbidden Rites)
tips.g4_11_2: Keep going north. A checkpoint means you took the wrong fork — go back and take the other path
tips.p1_1: Checkpoint hidden in the darkness bottom-left. After Isolde and Heldra, Stones of Serle is bottom-right
tips.p1_2: Six outer runed megaliths → Siora in the middle → wait and talk to Una
tips.p1_3: Holten is at the far end
tips.p1_4: Wolvenhold is top-right. Holten Estate is at 9 o'clock from the Wolvenhold entrance
tips.p1_6: Floor 1 → stairs to floor 2 → back down to floor 1; circle the building widely. Elswyth and Wulfric in the middle
tips.p2_town: The Khari Crossing portal is at the bottom right
tips.p2_1: Akthi and Anundr to the right (talk to Risu in town = passives +2). Follow the right wall to the stairs → Molten Shrine (5% maximum life)
tips.p2_2: Head down toward 6 o'clock following the left wall to Sel Khari Sanctuary
tips.p2_3: Elzarah is in the far diagonal corner
tips.p2_5: Vornas is at the end of the map
tips.p2_6: Follow the right wall to the Seven Pillars and pick a blessing (changeable) → Zado top-right
tips.p2_7: Azmadi top-right → the great Barya → talk to Zado
tips.p3_1: Kriar Village is usually at 11 o'clock, counter-clockwise
tips.p3_2: Go to the end and kill Lythara → +40 spirit
tips.p3_3: Follow the right wall to Howling Caves. Rakkar is top-left
tips.p3_4: The Yeti is at the very bottom (6 o'clock) → give the Ice Fang to Hilda in town = passives +2
tips.p3_5: Elder Madox at 11 o'clock → pick one unique item (not a permanent reward, skip it if you're in a hurry)
tips.p3_6: Stormgore at the end of the path. ⚡ His opening lightning attack hits very hard → dodge it right away and check your lightning resistance
tips.p3_7: The two bosses chant a ritual until you step in → fight. Done when Zolin surrenders → talk to Doryani in town (no need to come back here)
